text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for putting this proposal 
together so swiftly, Big Sis Groove. 
I see—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Our booth will be... an "Underworld-Themed 
Concept Cafe"...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(A cafe booth is a Holy Hoof Festival 
classic... Even with little experience, 
it's easy to visualize. And on top of 
that, this theme—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The Holy Hoof Festival takes place right 
around Halloween. 
A seasonal concept with a Halloween flair 
is perfectly suited for the occasion.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Seasonal flair... Teacher—I mean, your 
mother, often says the same thing. 
Back at the academy, seasonal events were 
held regularly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Cherishing annual traditions and 
setting distinct milestones— 
that is a philosophy Tracen Academy shares 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
For the Holy Hoof Festival, I want our 
fans to truly immerse themselves 
in the autumn atmosphere and the spirit of 
Halloween.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I understand the project's concept now. 
However... are the three of us going to 
run this cafe alone?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, that would be unfeasible. I have 
already assembled 
a team capable of handling the kitchen and 
interior decorations.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Kitchen and interior... That means the 
floor staff will be—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Those positions are vital to establishing 
the cafe's atmosphere. 
As core members, that duty falls to us. 
...Are we agreed?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...U-Understood.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Everything is moving along... with absurd 
efficiency—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As mentioned earlier, a Festival Booth 
Contest will be held this year. 
Which means our booth is eligible to 
compete.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If we are participating, then I want to 
aim for victory. 
I will prove I am "the strongest" here as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. ...Well then, that is all for 
today's meeting. 
Tomorrow, we take on the most crucial 
task: costume shopping!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Good morning. 
...Air Groove-san?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
! Whoops— Good morning, Groove. 
Heh, arriving this far ahead of schedule 
is just like you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...What were you reading just now? 
Was that... student council paperwork?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there were some Holy Hoof Festival 
documents I needed to review urgently. 
I was so engrossed I didn't notice you. My 
apologies.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Aren't you taking on far too much? 
Your vice president workload must be 
surging this time of year as it is—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
And now you're leading... a massive 
project like this, dragging us along too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's this... Don't tell me you're 
worried about me? 
I'm well used to this level of work. 
There's no need for concern.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, how about yourself? You 
aren't pushing yourself too hard, are you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am. 
Every single thing here... is unfamiliar 
to me...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Well, that's only natural. 
Still—I'll support you as much as I can. 
See it through to the end, Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ever since you were young, you've always 
pushed forward and grown entirely on your 
own. 
It's because of all that hard work that 
you are the wonderful person you are 
today.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why—from now on, 
you should try "achieving something 
alongside others."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Take everything you've built and learned, 
and apply it within a group. 
I'm certain new paths will open up for you 
if you do—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You have a remarkable knack for picking up 
on others' subtle feelings, after all. 
I think working the floor and serving 
guests suits you quite well.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...There's no... way—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis Groove, Groove-senpai—! 
I apologize for keeping you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh, don't rush, Dura. We're still five 
minutes early. 
—Now that we're all here, shall we head 
inside?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I tried on the outfit you specified, 
but... 
Big Sis Groove, what is this...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's a baseline for our concept. 
Given our "Underworld" theme, I figured—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A dignified and luxurious presence, like a 
demon or Count Dracula, 
would match your demeanor perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We'll build our direction from here by 
adding accessories and trims. 
This shop handles major alterations and 
custom tailoring as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what do you think... Groove, 
care to share your thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...U-Um—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san... carries herself with such 
nobility. 
Perhaps a slightly deeper shade...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Like... yes, wine red—for example.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oho, excellent idea! I saw one just a 
moment ago—yes, this one! 
Dura, try changing into this!

text_block_list.name: Double Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's perfect... 
It's absolutely perfect...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
D-Do you really think so? Thank you very 
much...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. A noble Count Dracula—would you 
not say? 
It complements your refined elegance and 
commanding presence beautifully.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The wine red truly brings it out... 
The leather sheen gives it such a 
luxurious touch—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—T-Then let us finalize this as my 
costume.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Next is... Alve-senpai. 
Why don't we start by trying on that dress 
over there?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, I—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh, fine choice, Dura! 
It has turned out to be a magnificent 
dress—dark, yet undeniably glamorous.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Aloof, yet breathtakingly beautiful... 
It suits you remarkably well, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, wait... I don't really need anything 
like this. 
Just whatever is fine...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense. Your outfit must be nothing 
short of perfection as well. Since we are 
at it, I'd like a matching motif with 
Dura... How about a cravat at the collar?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Matching with you, Senpai... It would be 
an honor. 
...I shall devote myself to ensuring I do 
not fall short beside you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...There's no need to get so weirdly 
worked up...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Come now, order whatever you like without 
hesitation. 
This is a splendid opportunity to learn 
about our beverages and sweets.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Above all else—the two of you must enjoy 
this project yourselves. 
If you wish to entertain the fans, that is 
where you must begin.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Sister Groove... Yes, understood. 
In that case, I will... let's see, I will 
have the Special Chocolate Sundae—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Duramente-san... Her eyes have been 
sparkling this entire time. 
It must be because she's tackling this 
with so much enthusiasm, truly.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...And in the end, so am I— 
Because she pulls me along so... so 
powerfully...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: You really are... something else—
